Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild basophilia. Red cell parameters, renal, liver, and metabolic panels are within normal limits. SARS-CoV-2 RNA is not detected. The hematological findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or an acute viral infection (other than COVID-19); clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
